ordinance.code_version: American Legal Publishing, Cottage Grove Code of Ordinances, 2026 S-8 (current)

district_conditions.B-3|P-B|M-U: s.11-8-2 use table row 'Cannabis retail': C (conditional use permit) in B-3, P-B, M-U; blank in B-1, B-2
district_conditions.AG|I: s.11-4-18.G.4 'No retail sales are allowed in the Agricultural or Industrial zoning districts.'
district_conditions.UNVERIFIED: the same use table also carries a row 'Cannabis or intoxicating CBD sales' marked P in B-3, P-B, M-U. The specific 'Cannabis retail' row (C) is used here; the 2025 Venus Creations application went through a CUP, which matches C. PUD overlays not modelled.

buffers.measured_from: storefront of the proposed cannabis or hemp retail use
buffers.measured_to: property line of every other cannabis or lower-potency hemp edible use
buffers.cite: s.11-4-18.G.7: 'Distances ... are measured from the storefront of a cannabis or lower-potency hemp edible retail use to the property line of all other cannabis or lower-potency hemp edible uses.' G.7.a: 'There must be at least one thousand feet (1,000') between each cannabis or lower-potency hemp edible use.' G.7.e(2): on-sale/off-sale liquor stores selling hemp beverages are exempt and 'their use does not count against other cannabis and lower-potency hemp edible uses'.
buffers.layer: data/raw/ocm_retail_sites_south_metro.geojson (OCM licensed list 2026-10-05, geocoded; liquor stores dropped)
buffers.implementation_note: measured from the candidate's lot line, not its storefront, so a lot is excluded if ANY part of it is within 1,000 ft (conservative; the storefront is always inside the lot). Existing uses are promoted to their whole parcel, as the code says.
buffers.UNVERIFIED: OCM list carries no address for non-retail uses (Rise cultivation/manufacturing and the Hohensteins hemp warehouse are licensed in Cottage Grove with 'N/A'), so they cannot be placed. Liquor exemption is inferred from the business name. Uses across the city line (Woodbury, St Paul Park, Newport) are counted.

buffers.cite: s.11-4-18.G.7.b(1) 'More than one thousand feet (1,000') from a school as measured from property line of the school to the cannabis business'; SCHOOL = public school (M.S. 120A.05) or nonpublic school reporting under 120A.24 (s.11-4-18.C)
buffers.where: countyname in ('Washington', 'Dakota', 'Ramsey') and graderange is not null and (graderange like '%KG%' or regexp_matches(graderange, '[0-9]'))
buffers.UNVERIFIED: MDE program points include ALC, transition and district-program sites with K-12 grades; all are counted. 'to the cannabis business' read as the cannabis lot line.

buffers.measured_from: property line of the day care
buffers.cite: s.11-4-18.G.7.b(2) 'More than five hundred feet (500') from a day care that is in the B1, B2, B3, PB, or MU zoning district'; DAY CARE = 'A location licensed with the Minnesota Department of Human Services to provide the care of a child outside the child's own home' (s.11-4-18.C)
s.11-4-18.G.7.b(3); RESIDENTIAL TREATMENT FACILITY = 24-hour program licensed under Minn. R. 9520.0500-9520.0670 / ch. 245I (s.11-4-18.C)
buffers.UNVERIFIED: SAMHSA federal locator stands in for the DHS licence list (captcha-walled). No residential facility found within 12 km of Cottage Grove; a DHS-licensed IRTS not listed with SAMHSA would be missed.

buffers.measured_from: location of the public park attraction
buffers.cite: s.11-4-18.G.7.b(4) 'an attraction within a public park that is regularly used by minors, such as, but not limited to a playground, athletic field, athletic court, picnic area or permanent restrooms, pavilion or park building, disc golf features'
buffers.UNVERIFIED: OpenStreetMap features clipped to the city's 2019 park polygons, Dakota County and Met Council regional parks; OSM completeness for small parks is not guaranteed.

spacing_note: s.11-4-18.G.7.a counts hemp (LPHE) retailers too; G.7.e(1) exempts hemp retailers from G.7.b but not from G.7.a.
cap_note: no numeric cap found in s.11-4-18 or the use table. UNVERIFIED: Title 3 registration chapter not read.
registrations_issued: UNVERIFIED; OCM list 2026-10-05 shows 1 cannabis retail site in Cottage Grove (Holstrum LLC, 8711 E Point Douglas Rd S)
other_rules: no cannabis use as part of an Adult Use Establishment (G.3)
max two signs; no blinking signs; no interior sign visible outside (G.8)
security plan approved by Director of Public Safety (G.10)

sanity_check.case: Venus Creations LLC, 7430 80th St S: CUP denied 2025-12-15, reported 930 ft from a hemp retailer inside the 1,000-ft buffer
sanity_check.parcel: 0802721340020 (Oak Park Commons LLC, 7420 80th St S; Census geocode of 7430 80th St S falls inside it)

planner_contact: Community Development, City of Cottage Grove, 12800 Ravine Pkwy S, 651-458-2800
notes: UNVERIFIED reading of G.7.a: the one OCM-licensed cannabis shop in the city, Holstrum LLC (8711 E Point Douglas Rd S, parcel 2102721120012), sits ~9 ft from the Target parcel and ~270 ft from a Holiday, both OCM-licensed hemp (LPHE) retailers. Either it predates those hemp licences or the city does not count every hemp seller. This build counts every non-liquor LPHE retailer, which is the literal text and is what the city applied to Venus Creations (hemp shop Moon Soon Tobacco).
